summary: Fall Guys entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Fall Guys
entries.definitive_edition: Current Epic Games Store Windows build

primary.version: Current Epic Games Store live-service version
primary.why: Fall Guys is now a free cross-platform live service under Epic, with Epic account cross-play, cross-platform parties, and cross-progression. Windows PC via Epic gives the cleanest current capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Epic Games Store build on Windows. Record Epic account/linking state, season/update, round/mode, custom Creative course details, party/cross-play status, and cosmetics if relevant.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service content, cosmetics, collaborations, and rounds change. Record season/update and account state.
